name: Goliath
whenBasis: In the reigns of Saul and David, dated by counting back from Solomon; 1 Samuel 13:1, which gives Saul's age and years, is damaged in the Hebrew.
summary: A champion of the Philistines from Gath, six cubits and a span tall, in bronze armour, whose spear shaft was like a weaver's beam. For forty days he challenged Israel to send a man to fight him. The shepherd boy David went out with a sling, struck him in the forehead with a stone and cut off his head with his own sword, which was later kept at Nob.
body: His armour is described piece by piece: a bronze helmet, a coat of scale armour weighing five thousand shekels, bronze greaves, a bronze javelin, a spear with an iron point weighing six hundred shekels. Saul and all Israel are dismayed.

David answers his curse: “You come against me with sword and spear and javelin, but I come against you in the name of the LORD of Hosts.” Goliath falls face down, and the Philistines flee. David later takes his sword from the priest at Nob. 2 Samuel 21:19 credits Elhanan with killing Goliath the Gittite, and 1 Chronicles 20:5 says Elhanan killed Goliath's brother.

moments.text: “In the name of the LORD of Hosts”

later.text: The Dead Sea Scroll of Samuel (4QSamᵃ), the Septuagint and Josephus give his height as four cubits and a span, about two metres, instead of six cubits and a span, about three.
